text:
maria: FYI I pushed a router-first packing prototype to the feature branch. primary goal: lower p99 for small chat requests by doing packing earlier in the route layer. rough perf notes in the PR.
kevin: Nice. Quick question — where does coalesce live in that flow? still runtime or router now?
maria: Router now. idea is pack across concurrent inflight requests before they hit the runtime so we avoid per-GPU enqueue jitter. runtime still does final alignment + KV cache pinning.
sam: Concern: cross-tenant packing at the router seems risky for fairness and tail isolation. how do we avoid hungry tenants stealing slots?
maria: Good call. Prototype uses soft quotas + per-tenant token bucket in router. if over threshold we spill to a per-tenant fastpath that bypasses cross-tenant packing.
olga: Can you paste the policy snippet? want to see thresholds.
maria: Sure — here's the minimal config I'm testing:```yaml
router_packing:
  enabled: true
  global_pack_window_ms: 8
  soft_quota_tokens: 1000
  per_tenant_fastpath_threshold: 0.7  # fraction of tenant quota
  kv_warmup_hint: true
```
natalie: Observability note — last time we pushed router-level packing we saw a KV cache miss spike and token-cost regressions for long-seq jobs. Do we have a warmup/affinity plan?
maria: Added a lightweight "kv_warmup_hint" header that tells the runtime to prefetch K/V for a batch if router saw a prefix match. Also expose a metric `router.prefetch_hints` so we can correlate with `runtime.kv_miss_rate`.
kevin: Can we run an A/B: 10% canary router-first packing vs 90% runtime-only? Key metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, runtime.kv_miss_rate, tokens/req, and tenant fairness (max-ratio-of-throughput).
maria: Yep. I'll wire that up in the routing layer and add the fallback: if `runtime.kv_miss_rate` crosses 3% absolute, force degrade to runtime-only for that shard.
sam: Also add a guard for very small requests that shouldn't be coalesced (chat typing latency). maybe < 16 tokens bypass packing.
olga: Agree. And add a tunable to keep hot-tenants pinned to their own lane if they cause >X eviction events.
infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued for cluster:infra-canary-7 in ~30m — watching for `router.prefetch_hints` and `runtime.kv_miss_rate`.
maria: thanks — i'll post a quick test plan in the PR but summary: canary 10%, measure 30m windows, rollback if p99 increases or kv_miss_rate delta > 3%.
kevin: If this looks good we can fold the router hints into the rollout config for dedicated as an opt-in. Nice work — this path avoids touching runtime scheduling primitives in the short term. :thumbsup:
natalie: One last thing — add an eval prompt set that stresses KV locality (long documents + repeated prefixes). that'll catch cold-warmup regressions early.
maria: on it. i'll update the PR with tests and dashboards. action items: Maria = canary+dashboards; Kevin = fairness metric query; Sam = threshold suggestions; Olga = eviction guards.
maria: thanks all :rocket:
